details: @reause/math@0.1.2 is a React math utility library that re-exports VueUse math functions (useAbs, useCeil, useClamp, useProjection, logicAnd/Or/Not, useSum, useMax, useMin, usePrecision, useRound, useTrunc, useMath, createProjection, createGenericProjection). The shipped dist/index.js and dist/index.iife.js contain only pure arithmetic functions with no network access, no subprocess execution, and no lifecycle hooks. The package depends on @reause/shared@0.1.2. No malicious runtime behaviour is present in the published code.
